question_text: Which two crowd camera locations had the most similar hourly activity patterns on 2025-12-08? Compare all pairs of crowd cameras by how closely their hourly average head_counts track each other.
answer_text: The two crowd camera locations with the most similar hourly activity patterns on 2025-12-08 were "DemoBooth_Intel" and "DemoBooth_NVIDIA".

citations.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (ch1:CrowdHour)-[:AT_CAMERA]->(c1:Camera)
  WHERE ch1.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch1.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN c1.camera_location AS location1, ch1.hour_utc AS hour1, ch1.avg_hc AS avg_hc1
}
WITH location1, hour1, avg_hc1
CALL {
  MATCH (ch2:CrowdHour)-[:AT_CAMERA]->(c2:Camera)
  WHERE ch2.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND ch2.hour_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
  RETURN c2.camera_location AS location2, ch2.hour_utc AS hour2, ch2.avg_hc AS avg_hc2
}
WITH location1, location2, hour1, hour2, avg_hc1, avg_hc2
WHERE location1 < location2 AND hour1 = hour2
WITH location1, location2, sum(abs(avg_hc1 - avg_hc2)) AS similarity_score
RETURN location1, location2
ORDER BY similarity_score ASC
LIMIT 1
